detailed_description:
Angular stylised 3D animation, brush-stroke texture, Horsell, Surrey, 1894, greenish daylight from the left, black shadows.
[Shot 1] From 00:00 to 00:08. The shot opens on an insert low in the knee-deep heather at nightfall: the black knees and boots of <Subject 1> in the grey herringbone tweed suit and the straw boater with a black band, his dark moustache neat standing at the left of the picture, a dry furze bush at the centre with its spines standing out black, the ground smoking in a curving line through the heather between them, and the pale blur of the sand ring beyond; only that object and what touches it is in frame. The camera is in the heather at the height of a kneeling man, two long strides from the bush, a 50mm lens. White flame breaks out at the CENTRE. At the first frame the Narrator's black knees and boots stand at the LEFT third of the frame from the TOP third to the BOTTOM edge. The dry furze bush stands at the CENTRE from the CENTRE to the BOTTOM edge. The shot is inside this place: Horsell Common at nightfall in 1894: the heather and the furze reading black, a low raw ring of flung yellow sand round the crater a hundred yards off with a smooth humped dome lifting over its rim and a thin jointed mast beside it, a scattered wedge of small dark figures out on the heather beyond the sand. The camera pans right with small amplitude from <Subject 1>'s black knees across to the furze bush, travelling a finger's breadth as the whole bush takes fire at once with a flat thud and burns white from the middle out, and the heather beyond it smokes and cracks along the same curving line, from 00:00 to 00:04. At 00:04 the flame throws up a sheet of sparks and the burnt heather stems curl over toward the camera, and the movement continues to the last frame of the shot. By 00:08 the camera is panning right through the last frame, and the action continues with it.

overall_soundscape: The ambience of Horsell Common at nightfall in 1894: the heather and the furze reading black runs under the whole take: its own air, the surfaces underfoot and the fabric of the place around it. Cloth, boots and the small sounds of hands on wood, glass and iron carry the physical action throughout.
